subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 佩丽卡, the character in <Picture 1>: an anime-style young woman with waist-length ash-blonde hair, large pointed grey-white beast ears with feathery fur tufts and a silver clip on the left ear, blue eyes, a white sleeveless high-neck dress with a black collar and a red-and-blue tab, a light-blue belt at the waist, a white cropped jacket with pale blue quilted sleeves and a metal shoulder plate, dark gloves, black tights, black strappy heels, and a yellow tool on her left thigh strap.
<Subject 2> is the strategic operations command room in <Picture 2>: dark-blue metal walls and ceiling with parallel light strips, two rows of long consoles with slanted terminals and black chairs facing a sunken central floor, a wide curved tactical display of blue and red vectors across the far wall flanked by two vertical screens, and potted plants at both ends of the room.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video follows <Subject 1>, 佩丽卡, walking through <Subject 2> in one continuous frontal tracking shot that rises from a low angle to her face as she scans the room; her survey ends in a brief, suppressed smile under a serious expression, with her appearance and the command-room environment preserved from <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her ash-blonde hair, fur-tufted beast ears, blue eyes, white high-neck dress, light-blue belt, white jacket with quilted sleeves, dark gloves, black tights, and strappy heels are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the dark-blue command room, ceiling light strips, console rows, curved tactical display, vertical screens, and potted plants are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video uses stylized 3D animation rendered with a 2D cel-shaded finish, stable contour lines, clean color blocks, stepped shadow bands, and controlled highlights; three-dimensional volume, perspective, and occlusion stay consistent as the character and camera move. The room is lit by cool blue display light and warm white ceiling strips.
[Shot 1] One continuous frontal tracking shot begins at ankle level inside <Subject 2>, the command room from <Picture 2>, then rises to 佩丽卡 (<Subject 1>, the character in <Picture 1>) as she walks forward through it. Low in the frame, her black strappy heels and black tights step at a measured pace across the polished dark floor and its yellow guide lines; the hem of her white jacket sways and her heels click softly, her dark-gloved hands resting loosely at her sides with relaxed fingers. The camera retreats at slow speed directly in front of her and rises with a large-amplitude pedestal-up movement, gliding past her knees, the light-blue belt at her waist, and the yellow tool on her left thigh strap, reaching her chest as she turns her head slowly to her left; her long ash-blonde hair and fur-tufted ears swing with the turn, and her blue eyes travel across the wall displays and console rows without settling. She brings her head back toward the center and glances once to her right past the slanted terminals. When the camera arrives at her face at eye level, her gaze lifts toward the wide curved tactical display at the far end of the room and stops; her serious expression does not change as one corner of her mouth lifts slightly into a faint, closed-mouth smile, her ears tipping forward, then she presses her lips together briefly and the smile fades back into composed stillness that she holds, still walking, until the video ends at 8.00 seconds. Characters never look into the camera. No on-screen text.

overall_soundscape: A low, steady hum from the room's ventilation and display arrays runs throughout. 佩丽卡's heels click rhythmically on the polished floor beneath soft rustles of jacket fabric and hair, with faint electronic warble from the surrounding screens.
